description: This file contains PHP classes implementing internal Smarty plugin compilation logic for {block} and {/block} tags, defining how block templates are compiled into PHP code within Smarty templating system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Block
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {block} tags in Smarty templates, generating PHP classes that implement block logic, including handling nested blocks and inheritance.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Blockclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of the {/block} closing tags in Smarty templates, generating PHP code to finalize block definitions and manage inheritance.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles Smarty {block} and {/block} template tags into corresponding PHP classes and code structures, managing attributes, inheritance, and scoping.
